161623: The strongest being who once unified Mizgarz and was feared as "The Black-Winged Overlord". Was sealed after a battle with The Seven Heroes, but was summoned back into the world 200 years later.
289014: A one-of-a-kind monster called the "Rainbow Sheep", who was taken in by Lufas and made the first member of her Twelve Heavenly Stars, representing the Ram constellation. In spite of his feminine human form, he is male.
289015: A demon who faithfully serves in Lufas's Twelve Heavenly Stars, representing the Goat constellation. He is feared by all as the "Demon Lord Aigokeros". His anthropomorphic form is that of an elderly butler, and although he is loyal to Lufas, he can also tend to run amok.
289017: A blue-haired girl who the resurrected Lufas met at her former base, the Tower of Mafahl. She claims to be Lufas's loyal retainer and has been waiting for her return for 200 years.
289020: An artificial golem in the form of a maid, who is a member of Lufas's Twelve Heavenly Stars representing the Scales constellation.
289022: A heaven-winged girl raised in Vanaheimr by her mentor, Parthenos.
289027: An ordinary high school boy who, after Lufas' resurrection, was brought to Mizgarz via a hero summoning ceremony. With an extremely average body and no special skills at all, he sets out to defeat the Demon Lord and Lufas, both of whom threaten humanity.
289028: One of Lufas' former comrades and one of the Seven Heroes. Has outstanding combat and magic power even among vampires, and after Lufas' sealing founded the Kingdom of Mjolnir, where she dominates all immortal monsters.
289032: The ruler of the demons. After Lufas' sealing, he won the battle against the Seven Heroes and cursed their bodies, taking away their powers. Since then, he has intensified his armies' offensive against humanity and continues to threaten their existence.
358430: A human woman who represents the Maiden of Lufas's Twelve Heavenly Stars. A direct descendant of the "Aeneas Family", a race of primordial humans created by the goddess to act as her agents.
374199: One of the Seven Heroes, and one of Lufas' closest friends. Widely known as the "Sword King" Alioth, who sealed Lufas away 200 years ago.
374200: One of the Seven Heroes and Lufas' close friend. In present day, he is called the "Wisdom King" as he rules the kingdom of Svel.
374201: One of Lufas' old friends and a member of the Seven Heroes, now known as the "Sky King" and ruler of Gjallarhorn. As a result of his loss against the demon king, he was cursed and lost his right wing, as well as half of his strength.
374855: One of the Seven Luminaries, the Demon King's elite force. Despite his appearance, he likes to dispatch his opponents through cunning.
374856: One of the Seven Luminaries, the Demon King's elite force. Has Fire affinity, and aims to kill the Seven Heroes to win the Demon King's favor.
